title: Redstrike CVE Intel
description: Emitted by the cve-intelligence capability agent: detected components mapped to applicable CVEs, KEV/EPSS-prioritized (scripts/cve_prioritize.py). Consumed by exploit-generator + bug-bounty + the console /cve-intel page; confirmed-reachable entries also become findings.json. The CVE array is canonically `cves`; `entries` is an accepted alias some runs emit — the console reads either. Each element (either key) is a per-CVE row (see $defs/cve_entry), not a per-component group.

entries.description: Accepted alias for `cves` (some runs emit this key; the console reads either). Prefer `cves`.

source.description: advisory feed(s) the match came from — prefer >1.

kev.description: listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog — test first.

priority_rank.description: 1-based rank from scripts/cve_prioritize.py (KEV > EPSS > reachability > CVSS).

technique_seed.description: OPTIONAL. Derived only when this CVE is confirmed reachable: a METHODOLOGY-ONLY technique-CLASS hint the ROUTED Tier-2 executor consumes as its PRIORITIZED FIRST BENIGN PROBE (which KIND of weakness to probe, and where). It is NOT a concrete exploit string, NOT a named-product PoC, NOT a copied payload — any actual exploitation stays in exploit-generator behind its approval gate.

technique.description: A technique-CLASS description ONLY, e.g. 'server-side template expression evaluation via the vulnerable parameter', 'deserialization of attacker data at the import sink', 'expression-language evaluation in a typed request header' — methodology, never a literal payload or product-specific PoC.

routed_class.description: Optional Tier-2 executor class this seed routes to (e.g. ssti, deserialization, command-injection), per _contract/routing-map.json.

injection_point.description: Optional where-to-probe location CLASS (e.g. query parameter / typed header / body field / import sink) — a location class, not a concrete value.
